scope: Review of A38, A43 geometric remainder and A30 left-only Laplacian in the latest consolidated user packet. Not full certification of the advertised A1-A56 packet; pasted source ends within A50.
results: Unit defect implies nonzero V in a nontrivial ring.
The submitted cubic with extra -V is impossible on the unit defect level set.
The submitted geometric remainder without -V is impossible on the same level set.
With additive torsion-freeness, the submitted left-only Laplacian fails already at the identity operator.
replacements: delta(V)=1 implies the existing power recurrence V^(n+2)=V^(n+1)+V^n
limitations: No level-set existence theorem for every ring.
No Galois group, KKT identification, global geometry, or analytic zeta interpretation follows from these identities.
